title: Rams coach Sean McVay says Puka Nacua is 'doing really well' after rehab stint

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams coach Sean McVay says Puka Nacua is 'doing really well' after rehab stint
sources.description: The Rams expect Puka Nacua to participate in offseason workouts, are negotiating with Matthew Stafford on an extension and are open to Jimmy Garoppolo returning.
